description: A small shop: browse products, add them to the cart, change quantities, subscribe to the newsletter, check out.

bugs.title: "Add to cart" on the Notebook does nothing
Newsletter shows "Subscribed" although the API returns 500
Checkout accepts an empty email and places the order
Cart page throws a JavaScript error on load
Product images have no alt text
Subscribe button uses a hard-coded blue (#2f6fe4) instead of the primary token
Newsletter card stays white in dark mode
Product cards use a 7px radius that is not on the theme scale

howDetectionIsMeasured: Each bug is switched on alone. It counts as detected when at least one test that passes on the clean app fails, or a new quality warning appears. Failures on the clean app are false positives.
